_about: The welcome and rules cards. scripts/discord_cards.py turns the bot's own posts in each channel into these, in order, editing in place. <#name> becomes a link to that channel. Colours are the app's sunset palette.

cards.title: 🌴 Welcome to Grand Theft Auto VI HQ
cards.text: The community for **GTA 6 HQ**, an unofficial fan encyclopedia and field manual for Grand Theft Auto VI.

cards.title: ⚠️ Fan-made, not official
cards.text: This server and the app are made by fans. They are not run, approved or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

cards.title: 🖥️ Get the app
cards.text:
Free for Windows. The encyclopedia, the map and the Field Manual in one window.

**[Download the latest version](https://github.com/xpbeats00-sudo/gta6-hq/releases/latest)**

cards.title: 🧭 Where to go
cards.text:
📜 Read the rules in <#rules>
🚀 New versions of the app appear in <#releases>
💬 Talk about the game in <#general>
✏️ Found a wrong fact? Post it with a source in <#corrections>

cards.title: 🛟 Something not working?
cards.text: Ask in <#app-help>, report it in <#bug-reports>, or share an idea in <#suggestions>.
cards.footer: GTA 6 HQ is an unofficial fan project

cards.title: 📜 Rules
cards.text: Seven rules. Read them before you post.

cards.title: 1. Be decent
cards.text: No harassment, hate, slurs or personal attacks.

cards.title: 2. No leaks
cards.text: Do not post or link leaked or stolen material: builds, source code, unreleased footage or documents. Official trailers, screenshots and interviews are fine.

cards.title: 3. No spoilers outside the spoiler channels
cards.text: Story details go in the spoiler channels, and behind spoiler tags in images.

cards.title: 4. No piracy, cheats or account selling
cards.text: That includes modded accounts, money drops and cracked copies.

cards.title: 5. Say where facts come from
cards.text: In <#corrections> and <#news-and-trailers>, link your source. Label guesses as guesses.

cards.title: 7. Keep it legal and within Discord's rules
🛡️ Moderation
cards.text: Moderators may remove posts or members to keep the server usable. Questions about a decision go to a moderator in private, not in public channels.
cards.footer: GTA 6 HQ is an unofficial fan project
